basis: UI_AUDIT.md (2026-08-15) + static classification of the deployed catalogue
read_me_first: These are priors, not facts about the file you are about to edit. The tool may have changed since the audit. Step 1 of PORTING_PLAYBOOK.md re-derives every field below from the current source and records any disagreement; where they differ, the source wins and this map is corrected.

legend.archetype: calculator | studio | wizard | reference — the DiagramUI.app({layout}) value
legend.compute: live | run — whether a result follows every edit or an explicit action
legend.stage: what occupies the stage slot: canvas2d | svg | scene3d | table | none
legend.effort: S = under a day, M = one to three days, L = more than three days
legend.wave: 1 = broken on mobile, 2 = horizontal overflow, 3 = wizards and editors, 4 = the rest
legend.traps: defects found in the audit that the port must not carry over

waves.1: Unusable below 768px today: a fixed multi-column grid plus overflow:hidden makes regions unreachable, not merely cramped. Adopting the shell is the fix.
waves.2: Horizontal overflow at 390px from an inner min-width or an un-breakpointed inner grid.
waves.3: Wizards and graph/scene editors: the archetypes exist for them and the win is large.

framework_revision_note: Corrected for diagram-ui.js 2026-08-17.v3 / UI_FRAMEWORK_SPEC.md revision 2026-08-17a. Only entries the release made FACTUALLY WRONG were touched; the cards are otherwise unchanged and still date from the 2026-08-15 audit. See PORTING_PLAYBOOK.md §4.3a for the full list of deletions that the framework now hosts — collapsible panels, notices, splitters, region scrolling, transports, meters, legends, rich tables, grouped options and example selects — which this map does not repeat per card.
